title: Onyx -Pool &Gym-Walk 2 Best Hot Spots-On Music Row
description:
Welcome to Onyx, where sleek Music Row style sets the tone for your Nashville stay. Ease into the morning with coffee on the private balcony, spend sun-soaked afternoons by the heated pool, or relax in the resident lounge before exploring the city. Shop boutiques and grab rooftop drinks in The Gulch, stroll the lively Vanderbilt area, then head to Broadway for honky-tonks, live music, neon lights, and unforgettable nights just minutes from your door.

The space
⭐ Building Accommodations & Amenities:
- A quick 15-minute walk to Broadway, where live music spills onto the streets, rooftop bars stay buzzing, and every night turns into a story
- Unbeatable location just 1 minute from Vanderbilt University and 3 minutes from Belmont University, keeping you close to campus energy and everything around it
- Heated pool lined with loungers, cabanas, and skyline views—perfect for laid-back afternoons and easy evenings (open year-round 8 AM–10 PM, HOA discretion)
- Modern lobby lounge with comfortable seating and a built-in game area, designed for relaxing, connecting, and keeping the vibe going
- Fully equipped fitness and yoga center open from early morning to late night (5 AM–12 AM), so you can move on your schedule
- Pet-friendly building with a gated dog area and wash station, making it easy to bring your four-legged companion along
- Poolside lounge and cabanas available for private rentals, ideal for celebrations, gatherings, or adding something extra to your stay (inquire at booking)
- Secured building access with elevator entry for a smooth, convenient experience throughout your stay
- 24/7 front desk with hotel-style check-in, offering a seamless arrival and elevated feel from the moment you walk in
- Private balcony perfect for sipping morning coffee, enjoying fresh air, or winding down with evening drinks before a night out in Nashville

🛋️ Living Area:
- Comfortable living area designed for slow mornings, relaxed nights, and easy downtime between Nashville plans
- Cozy couch and two swivel armchairs create an inviting setup for conversation, cocktails, or kicking back after exploring Music Row
- Smart TV ready for streaming, game days, or background entertainment while you settle in for the evening
- Generous coffee table adds the perfect place for drinks, snacks, or cards for a casual night of lounging in style

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining:
- Stylish kitchen setup made for easy mornings, casual dinners, and everything in between during your Nashville stay
- Stainless steel appliances bring a polished, modern feel while keeping the space functional and guest-friendly
- Outfitted with a fridge, dishwasher, oven, 4-burner stovetop, microwave, and toaster for effortless meals, snacks, and leftovers
- Keurig coffee station stocked with coffee so you can fuel up before exploring Music Row, Broadway, and beyond
- Cozy indoor dining nook for 2, ideal for coffee before the day begins, quick bites, or a low-key evening in
- Outdoor dining area for 2 on the private balcony, perfect for fresh-air breakfasts, sunset drinks, or takeout with a view
- Kitchen Starter Kit: 1 sponge, 2 paper towels, 2 regular coffees, 1 vanilla coffee, 1 decaf coffee, 4 condiments, 1 dish soap, and 2 teas

🛌 Bedrooms:
- Primary Bedroom: Queen bed with a smart TV, closet space, and an en-suite bathroom
- 2nd Bedroom: Queen bed with a smart TV, closet space, and access to a Jack-and-Jill bathroom

🛁 Bathrooms:
- Primary Bathroom: Primary en-suite with a single vanity, LED Smart mirror, and a walk-in shower
- 2nd Bathroom: Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a single vanity, LED Smart mirror, and a walk-in shower

🚗 Parking:
- Paid street parking available
- Valet parking available
